text:
Aisha: Quick weekly health sync — noticed a spend anomaly for AcmeCorp. Hosted usage shows 7-day spend $23,400 vs committed $50,000. Also flagged a late-night burst on /api/generate at ~2024-09-01T02:12Z that pushed hourly spend to 2.5x expected. :warning:
Tom: link to dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/customers/acme/usage — looks like most tokens came from a single route and one API key.
Ravi: Do we have latency or error spikes coinciding with the burst?
Aisha: Yes — avg p95 jumped from 180ms to ~1.2s during the burst window. Error rate rose from 0.2% to 2.6%.
Marina: BillingBot noticed repeated small calls from the same key at high QPS. Reaction: :eyes: 
BillingBot: Automated alert: flagged anomalous token churn for key-XXXXX at 2024-09-01T02:10 UTC — spike score 8/10 — created ticket CS-4382.
Liam: Could be a customer experiment or a client-side retry loop. @Tom can you check request patterns? Maybe function/tool calling gone haywire.
Tom: Quick query I ran:
```
select route, count(*) as rps, sum(tokens) as tokens
from request_logs
where customer_id='acme' and ts >= '2024-08-25'
group by route
order by tokens desc
```
Tom: confirms 84% of tokens from /api/generate?session=playground and many requests are sub-second but huge token footprints.
Ravi: Ops note — region us-west-2 showed degraded 4xx rates during the same window; network retries might explain duplicates.
Aisha: Immediate actions: 1) Throttle the offending key to safe rate (Tom) 2) Open a customer enablement call to review prompt patterns (Aisha) 3) Eng to investigate retry amplification (Ravi).
Marina: I'll schedule the enablement call; suggested time tomorrow 14:00 PT. Adding enablement checklist.
Liam: Recommend temporary commit credit protection: apply soft-cap at 10k/day and notify customer before hard throttle. Ops: @BillingBot can you simulate impact?
BillingBot: Simulation: soft-cap at 10k/day reduces projected month-end overage from $26k to $4.2k. Notification template queued.
Aisha: I'll send a short email with recommended prompt changes and share our 'burst-smoothing' playbook.
Tom: Follow-up for this thread: add telemetry to surface per-key token histograms and flag repeats > X per minute. Filed ENG-952.
Aisha: Thanks all — I'll update Acme and post the playbook. Closing once we confirm throttling and customer agrees to call. :thumbsup:
Marina: noted — will post meeting invite and attach the report.
